title: RUM Telemetry: Buffered Observe to sendBeacon Flush
description: Trace how PerformanceObserver captures retroactive entries and flushes on visibilitychange without blocking bfcache.

steps.label: 1. Subscribe with buffered: true
steps.description: Observer attaches after hydration and reads LCP/longtask entries already recorded during boot.

steps.label: 2. Collect Attribution & LoAF
steps.description: Each entry exposes timing breakdown (element selector, script URL, startTime, duration).

steps.label: 3. Flush on visibilitychange (hidden)
steps.description: User backgrounds tab. navigator.sendBeacon queues the JSON payload asynchronously and leaves bfcache intact.
